makebit_car_init.tooltip: Initialize the MakeBit car PCA9685 motor driver (I2C address 0x41, 50Hz PWM). Place this block in setup before using car/servo/fan/LED blocks.

makebit_car_ctrl.tooltip: Control the car at default speed 255: forward, backward, turn left, turn right, stop, spin left, spin right.

makebit_car_ctrl_speed.tooltip: Control the car at the given speed (0-255): forward, backward, turn left, turn right, stop, spin left, spin right.

makebit_motor.tooltip: Control the left or right motor independently, forward or reverse, speed 0-255; speed 0 stops that motor.

makebit_car_servo.tooltip: Set the on-board servo (PCA9685 channel 3) angle, 0-180 degrees, pulse width 600-2400 microseconds.

makebit_car_fan.tooltip: Control the on-board fan motor (PCA9685 channels 4/5): forward, reverse or stop, speed 0-255; speed is ignored when Stop is selected.

makebit_buzzer.tooltip: Control the active buzzer module (triggered by LOW level): on or off.

makebit_car_led.tooltip: Headlight switch: on = white light at the global brightness (set with the headlight brightness block), off = off. Both headlights are wired in parallel on the same RGB channels and act together.

makebit_car_rgb.tooltip: Set a preset color for the car RGB headlight (PCA9685 channels 0/1/2).

makebit_car_rgb_val.tooltip: Set a custom headlight color from RGB components (0-255); output is scaled by the global brightness.

makebit_ultrasonic.tooltip: Measure distance with an external SR04 ultrasonic module (trigger/echo pins selectable). Returns centimeters; returns 0 on timeout (no echo within ~30ms, about 5m).

makebit_rgb_effect.tooltip: Run an effect on the RGB headlight: flow (six-color cycle), rainbow (hue sweep), breath, blink or off. Blocking until finished.

makebit_car_trim.tooltip: Correct forward drift: set left/right motor forward output percentage (0-100, default 100 = no trim). Drifting right -> decrease the left value; drifting left -> decrease the right value. Affects forward-driving wheels in forward/turn/spin; reverse unchanged.

makebit_rgb_brightness.tooltip: Set the global brightness (0-255, default 255 = full): subsequent headlight color, effect, on and custom RGB blocks render at this brightness.
